label: GOD_4 HAS_WILL_1, by the restricted Theta 5 principle at the joint-absence power (inference)
rule: Each GOD_4 holds the power; P2-prime, P5, the creator reading and factive giving make it a two-way giver; its set-up is invariant; apply argument C's conclusion
meaning: Each GOD_4 g exists at w and holds the power for the joint absence of the actual contingent concreta; P2-prime puts g at an accessible world v where they are all absent; P5 gives one, x; by the creator reading g gives x being at w, and by factive giving not at v. So g is a two-way giver at w; its set-up is invariant (holder premise); argument C's conclusion gives it will. Constructive.
